structure: 减省关系从句 + which 指代 + 不定式做定语
intro_zh: DHH（Ruby on Rails 作者、37signals 的 CTO）在 Lex Fridman 的节目里聊到长寿和「过度优化」。起因是有位播客主持人说喝了一杯红酒毁了三天——DHH 借喝酒这件事讲他为什么反感把生活里的一切都拿来优化，Lex 也插了一段在中国农村喝酒的经历。

sents.en: But just recently, we've been talking about this over-optimizers.
sents.zh: 不过就在最近，我们一直在聊这帮「过度优化」的人。

sents.en: I saw, uh, Chris Williamson, Modern Wisdom had a bit where he was like, "Yeah, okay, maybe we did go a little overboard."
sents.zh: 我看到 Chris Williamson，就是 Modern Wisdom 那位，有一段他说：「嗯，好吧，我们可能确实有点过头了。」

sents.en: And the triggering thing was the Diary of a CEO, where the host was saying something to the effect of, "I had a glass of wine and the next three days were ruined."
sents.zh: 导火索是 Diary of a CEO，主持人说了句大意是：「我喝了一杯红酒，接下来三天全毁了。」

sents.en: And that to me, I mean, in his circumstance, I'm sure that's true.
sents.zh: 这事在我看来——就他的情况而言，我相信是真的。

sents.en: Like, if you have not drank any alcohol for a very long time and you have just a little, I could see how it can have effect.
sents.zh: 你要是很久滴酒不沾，突然喝一点，有反应我能理解。

sents.en: But also there's something in that that just triggered a visceral reaction, I think, for a lot of people, and myself included, where I was like, "Fuck, man, I should have a glass of wine just right now, even though I don't usually drink."
sents.zh: 但这话里也有某种东西让很多人本能地反感，我也是，我当时就想：「靠，我现在就该来一杯，虽然我平时不怎么喝。」

sents.en: And in fact I think the alcohol question is a good microcosm to zoom in on.
sents.zh: 其实我觉得喝酒这个问题是个很好的缩影，值得凑近了看。

hl.text: a good microcosm to zoom in on
hl.note: 不定式做定语，介词 on 留在句尾：a microcosm to zoom in on = 值得凑近看的缩影。

sents.en: So we've all stopped drinking apparently, like alcohol sales are way down- ... certainly amongst young people.
sents.zh: 我们好像都不喝酒了，酒的销量跌得很厉害，年轻人里尤其明显。

sents.en: And then on the one hand, on the pure health metrics, whatever, we can go like, "Oh wow, isn't that great?"
sents.zh: 一方面，单看健康指标之类的，我们可以说：「哇，这不是挺好吗？」

sents.en: And then I go like, "Yeah, I'm not so sure it is."
sents.zh: 可我会说：「嗯，我不太确定这是好事。」

sents.en: Like the social lubricant that alcohol can provide may be missed, is missed.
sents.zh: 酒能起到的那种社交润滑作用，可能会让人怀念——不，是已经让人怀念了。

sents.en: I mean, we are in an absolute epidemic of loneliness and misery and depression and whatever, and a fair amount of it just probably comes because you're not interacting enough with other people.
sents.zh: 我们正处在一场孤独、痛苦、抑郁的大流行里，其中相当一部分很可能就是因为你和别人打交道太少。

sents.en: Now, that's before we even talk about coupling, right?
sents.zh: 这还没说到找对象呢，对吧？

sents.en: Like way down, people having a very hard time meeting a spouse.
sents.zh: 也是大跌，大家找个伴侣难得很。

hl.text: people having a very hard time meeting a spouse
hl.note: people (who are) having a hard time…：现在分词做后置定语，省掉 who are。

sents.en: And- ... a lot of that has moved over to apps that have all sorts of negative outcomes and consequences, right?
sents.zh: 而且这事很大一部分搬到了 app 上，带来各种负面的结果和后果，对吧？

sents.en: Like maybe we will look back, or maybe we already are looking back and thinking like, "Eh, do you know what?
sents.zh: 也许我们以后回头看，或者现在已经在回头看了，会想：「嗯，你知道吗？

sents.en: Maybe getting wasted every once in a while was not the worst thing in the world."
sents.zh: 偶尔喝个烂醉，也许并不是天底下最糟的事。」

sents.en: And whether wasted or not, maybe just having a couple of drinks every Friday or Saturday when you're out and about was part of what helped society get to where it is.
sents.zh: 就算不喝醉，也许每个周五周六出门时喝上两杯，本来就是帮社会走到今天的一部分。

sents.en: Maybe the fact that humans have literally been drinking for whatever it is, like 13,000 years for mending things, had a social purpose, and we pull out Chesterton's fence of our own chagrin, right?
sents.zh: 人类已经喝了不知道多久的酒，大概一万三千年吧，用它来修补关系——也许这件事本来就有它的社会功能，而我们没弄清这道篱笆为什么立在那儿就把它拆了，到头来懊恼的是自己，对吧？

sents.en: As you mentioned, in the spirit of that, so when I traveled across rural China, I did smoke a little bit in my early 20s, but I picked up just for that trip- - A social connector, right?
sents.zh: 说到这个——我当年穿越中国农村旅行的时候，我二十出头抽过一点烟，那趟旅行我又专门捡了起来——（DHH：社交的纽带，对吧？）

sents.en: And I drank humongous amounts, even though I don't really drink these days, because of the social thing.
sents.zh: 而且我喝了巨多的酒，虽然我现在基本不喝，就是因为社交。

sents.en: It's the way they show love.
sents.zh: 那是他们表达情意的方式。

sents.en: And I also ate a shitload of carbs, which- ...
sents.zh: 我还吃了一大堆碳水，而我——

sents.en: I'm usually low carb.
sents.zh: 我平时是低碳水的。

sents.en: I just like meat.
sents.zh: 我就爱吃肉。

sents.en: So just because it's the way they show love.
sents.zh: 就因为那是他们表达情意的方式。

sents.en: And actually even, it's in that society cigarettes, but in most societies, liquor is a thing to do together.
sents.zh: 其实在那个社会是烟，但在大多数社会，酒是大家凑在一起做的一件事。

hl.note: a thing to do together：不定式做定语，「大家一起做的一件事」。

sents.en: And it's a bond.
sents.zh: 它是一种纽带。

sents.en: It doesn't, the benefits that that entails can, in many situations, outweigh the negative consequences like long-term for whatever, however you measure them.
sents.zh: 它带来的好处，在很多情况下能盖过那些负面后果，比如长期的什么什么，不管你怎么衡量。

sents.en: And this is the myopia of modernity, that we reduce things down to like, well, one glass on this long run study meant that you had a 0.1% greater risk of some heart defect.
sents.zh: 这就是现代人的短视：我们把事情简化成——嗯，某个长期研究说，一杯酒让你得某种心脏问题的风险高了 0.1%。

sents.en: Yes, but if you didn't live at all, what's the point?
sents.zh: 是，可你要是压根没好好活过，那还有什么意义？

sents.en: And again, it's also easy to flip over the other side.
sents.zh: 当然，反过来走到另一个极端也很容易。

sents.en: Like the only way to live is to get drunk every weekend and eat a bunch of crap and smoke 40 cigarettes a day.
sents.zh: 比如说，活着的唯一方式就是每个周末喝醉、吃一堆垃圾食品、一天抽 40 根烟。

hl.note: the only way to live：way + to do，「活法」。

sents.en: No, it's not.
sents.zh: 不，不是的。

sents.en: Like it doesn't have to be the either/or.
sents.zh: 这事不必非此即彼。

sents.en: This is one of the reasons I stopped wearing my Oura Ring.
sents.zh: 这也是我不再戴 Oura Ring 的原因之一。

sents.en: So I wore the Oura sleep ring for many years, four years.
sents.zh: Oura 睡眠戒指我戴了很多年，四年。

sents.en: And one day I was just like, "I don't need to know that I had-" ...
sents.zh: 有一天我就想：「我不需要它来告诉我，我昨晚——」

sents.en: "a bad night of sleep."
sents.zh: 「没睡好。」

sents.en: Like I know.
sents.zh: 我自己知道啊。

sents.en: This added, I don't wanna call it an anxiety, I don't have a lot of anxiety, but this added just like reminder- ... that I had a bad night of sleep, what purpose is it actually playing here?
sents.zh: 它多出来的——我不想叫它焦虑，我这人没什么焦虑——就是多了个提醒，提醒我昨晚没睡好，这到底有什么用？

sents.en: Why do I need to have all these stats?
sents.zh: 我为什么需要这么多数据？

sents.en: Why do I need to optimize everything?
sents.zh: 我为什么什么都要优化？

sents.en: To the point where, again, after that single anecdote, you know, from Diary of a CEO, I was like, "Fuck, I kind of want the opposite."
sents.zh: 到了什么程度呢：听完 Diary of a CEO 那一个小故事，我就想：「靠，我反倒想反着来。」

sents.en: Like- I barely drink at all.
sents.zh: 我本来几乎不喝酒。

sents.en: A glass of wine once a month maybe.
sents.zh: 大概一个月一杯红酒。

sents.en: Like, do you know what?
sents.zh: 你知道吗？

sents.en: I should start, uh, just on the weekends, get a glass.
sents.zh: 我该开始，嗯，就在周末，来一杯。

sents.en: Maybe two.
sents.zh: 也许两杯。

shadow.tips: 断句：And in FACT / I think the ALcohol question / is a good MIcrocosm / to zoom IN on. zoom in on 三个词连读成 zoo-mi-non，in 重读；and in 连读。
断句：Maybe getting WASted / every once in a while / was NOT the worst thing in the world. once in a 连读 wun-si-na；worst thing 的 t 不爆破。
断句：YES, / but if you didn't LIVE at all, / what's the POINT? at all 连读成 a-dall；what's the 轻带，point 重读上扬后落下。
断句：Like the ONly way to live / is to get DRUNK every weekend / and eat a bunch of CRAP / and smoke FORty cigarettes a day. way to live 一口气；bunch of 连读 bun-chov；and 都弱读成 ən。

questions: What triggered this whole rant? Describe the thing the podcast host said.
Why does DHH think people drinking less may not be purely good news? (Try: "There are a lot of people having…")
What did Lex learn about drinking while traveling across rural China? (Try: "Liquor is a thing to…")
Why did DHH stop wearing his Oura Ring?
He says it doesn't have to be either/or. What is the middle way to live that he is describing?
Is there a number you track in trading or in life that is not worth tracking any more? (Try: "One stat not worth checking every day is…, which…")
